title: hub.toml doubles as machine database
note: Reserved sections exist (config.go toml tags: host_records..mirror_commits, PendingStoreSync :120, MirrorCommits :127; validators at :566-569; Undecoded refusal at ~:581-586). app_host_* is 14,242 non-test / 32,682 test lines; hostops 9,751. revised_fix_plan: Do not schedule as a refactor. Raise as a decision with Jesse: single source of truth for host records. Only after approval, write a design record; implementation is a separate multi-PR effort with recovery tests first.

revised_fix_plan: Delete the 23 undocumented knobs per original plan; also fix evener-hub.md:306 sentence pointing at nonexistent docs. Confirm with Jesse they are not tuned in any deployed hub.toml.

title: Memoized tree path and sync fallback production-dead
note: Dead in production: memoTree and memoTreeWithAuthority (web_api_tree.go:223,228; no callers), s.treeCache/hubcore.TreeCache (web.go:85,195), remoteTreeThreads (:667), refreshRemoteThreads (:678), navigationTreeInputs (:613), rowRenameable (:1514), liveEntry (:1523), remoteFetchGeneration (web.go:56; sole use :636 in the no-cache fallback). WRONG part: refreshRemoteThreadSnapshot and listThreadsWithFallback are production code: main_background.go:188 calls web.refreshRemoteThreadSnapshot for the cache refresher. The synchronous walk is therefore not 'unreachable'; only the cache==nil branch in remoteThreadFetch (:624-637) is test-only. Also remoteThreadFetch is used in prod by navigation snapshot (:465) and app_pin_section.go:197. hubTreeAttentionRank (:37,40) has 'var _ =' placeholder (confirmed).
revised_fix_plan: Delete memoTree, memoTreeWithAuthority, treeCache, hubcore.TreeCache(+test), remoteTreeThreads, refreshRemoteThreads, navigationTreeInputs, rowRenameable, liveEntry, remoteFetchGeneration, hubTreeAttentionRank, and the cache==nil fallback branch in remoteThreadFetch (default RemoteThreadCache in newWebServer). KEEP refreshRemoteThreadSnapshot and listThreadsWithFallback (used by main_background.go:188). Fix stale comments at web_api_tree.go:618-623 and main.go:505,939-945.

title: Doc and image routes resolve paths divergently; remote image-by-path misses artifacts root
note: Asymmetry real: local resolveLocalDocTarget (doc_serve.go:57-110) tries cwd then artifactsDocTarget for absolute paths, while sessionImageByPath (image_serve.go:281-307) uses only sessionCWD+ResolveInRoot. But the doc comment at image_serve.go:277-280 documents cwd-only as the contract, so it may be intentional; it must be confirmed with Jesse before treating as a bug. supportedOutputImageMedia(data, _ string) (output_images.go:303) unused second param confirmed; sessionImageByPath still passes filepath.Base(abs).
revised_fix_plan: Step 1: decide whether remote image-by-path should serve artifacts root (product call). Then extract shared resolveSessionFile only if so; otherwise only drop the unused param, unify readOutputImageFile/InRoot, merge proxy-status tables.

title: Navigation layer works around upstream grouping defect; re-validation; Context twins
note: Merge code (navigation_projection.go:312-357, comment explains the shared 'no-project' key from hubcore/tree.go:910,1013,1491) and repeated validateNavigationResourceSnapshot calls (normalize:159, delta:16,19,73, history:42, plus delta.Validate :66) confirmed. buildNavigationProjection (:155) and applyNavigationDelta's nil error (delta:84) confirmed; validNavigationTimestamp and cloneNavigationSnapshot have only test callers. But calling no-project multiplicity an 'upstream defect' is a judgment: the tree deliberately presents separate groups per grouping path, so changing hubcore to emit one project per Key alters tree presentation for other consumers. Validation at the publication boundary is a deliberate fence.
revised_fix_plan: Do the safe parts: delete test-only twins (take ctx everywhere), unused helpers, always-nil error, and 'V3'/Context naming. Treat the upstream-merge move and validation reduction as a separate design discussion; if done, keep reconstruction equality and publish-time validation.

title: Split the 56k-line main package
note: Counts verified: 56,197 non-test / 192,767 test lines, 463 test files; sole production importer cmd/evener/main.go:20.
